correctness.rationale: For any primitive 2-cycle, shift coordinates enforce the unique unordered pair u+v=−(1+sigma+delta), alpha=alpha*−(u−v)^2/4, so the global real count is exact. Direct multiplication of two Jacobians yields P(lambda)=lambda^3−(1+E−delta^2−4h)lambda^2+E lambda−delta^2. A reciprocal Schur reduction produces three necessary and sufficient strict positivity inequalities 4(1+delta^2)h, 4(1−delta^2)(Wflip−h), 4delta^2(WNS−h). Algebraic factorization E−(1−2delta^2)=(sigma+delta)^2+(3delta−1)(delta+1) proves mechanism cases, equality and the delta=1/3 sharp border. All critical polynomial identities were checked by packaged standalone SymPy code, with 68 supplementary parameter tests; none of the finite tests is treated as the infinite proof. At neutral spectra, the claim asserts no nonlinear dynamics.

originality.rationale: The 2022 source derives general 3D multiplier geometry, an explicit fixed-point flip locus, and numerically illustrates period-two orbits; it does not state or establish the exact all-real-space primitive two-cycle census, closed sink wedge and delta=1/3 transition surface. The 2023 same-author continuation research develops anti-integrability and numerical low-period tracking, with an analytic fixed-point flip criterion, but no full two-cycle Schur result. Related published planar two-cycle theorems address different maps and do not imply this three-dimensional result. Novelty is assessed against inspected material rather than inferred from missing search hits.
residual_risks: Priority may exist in an earlier work on the same quadratic recurrence under alternative Gonchenko coordinates (M1,M2,B), or in a longer dynamical-bifurcation source not located during the search.
The older Zheng et al. full text was not read here; its explicitly reported model is different, limiting relevance, but a hidden broader treatment cannot be categorically excluded.
No external independent priority or mathematical validation has been performed.

value.rationale: The originators numerically contrast a strongly contracting 3D Hénon orbit which period-doubles with a moderately contracting orbit which undergoes a complex pair crossing. The new theorem gives a complete global primitive-two-cycle count, an exact finite-parameter attraction wedge, and an analytical phase boundary at determinant delta=1/3 between possible and impossible flip-first destabilization. This naturally interprets those numerically observed alternatives, is stronger than a fixed-point flip formula, is not a routine arbitrary parameter slice and does not claim unrelated higher-period results.
